feats.name: Crafter
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Tool Proficiency.** You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.

**Discount.** You get a 20 percent discount when you buy a nonmagical item.

**Fast Crafting.** When you finish a Long Rest, you can make one simple piece of adventuring gear with Artisan's Tools you are proficient with (for example a Ladder with Carpenter's Tools, or a Pouch with Leatherworker's Tools). It falls apart when you finish your next Long Rest.

feats.name: Healer
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Battle Medic.** With a Healer's Kit, you can take the Utilize action and spend one use of the kit to tend a creature within 5 feet. That creature can spend one of its Hit Point Dice; you roll it, and it regains that many Hit Points plus your Proficiency Bonus.

**Healing Rerolls.** When you roll a die to restore Hit Points with a spell or with Battle Medic, you can reroll a 1. You must use the new roll.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Luck Points.** You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. They come back after a Long Rest.

**Advantage.** When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll.

**Disadvantage.** When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give that roll Disadvantage.

feats.name: Musician
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Instrument Training.** You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

**Encouraging Song.** As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on an instrument you are proficient with. A number of allies who hear it, up to your Proficiency Bonus, gain Heroic Inspiration.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Enhanced Unarmed Strike.** When your Unarmed Strike hits and deals damage, you can deal 1d4 + your Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage instead of the usual damage.

**Damage Rerolls.** When you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll a 1. You must use the new roll.

**Improvised Weaponry.** You are proficient with improvised weapons.

**Push.** Once per turn, when your Unarmed Strike hits a creature as part of the Attack action, you can deal the damage and also push it 5 feet away from you.

feats.name: Tough
feats.description: Your Hit Point maximum goes up by twice your character level when you take this feat. Each time you gain a level after that, it goes up by 2 more.

feats.name: Actor
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Impersonation.** While you are disguised as a real or made-up person, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception or Performance) checks to make others believe you are that person.

**Mimicry.** You can copy the voice of a person or the sounds of a creature you have listened to for at least 1 minute. A listener can tell it is fake with a Wisdom (Insight) check against DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Climb Speed.** You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

**Hop Up.** When you are Prone, standing up costs you only 5 feet of movement.

**Jumping.** You can make a running Long Jump or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

feats.name: Charger
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Improved Dash.** When you take the Dash action, your Speed goes up by 10 feet for that action.

**Charge Attack.** If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target right before hitting it with a melee attack roll as part of the Attack action, pick one: the attack deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type, or you push the target up to 10 feet away if it is no more than one size larger than you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

feats.name: Chef
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Cook's Utensils.** You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils if you don't already have it.

**Replenishing Meal.** During a Short Rest, if you have ingredients and Cook's Utensils, you can cook a special meal. Up to 4 + your Proficiency Bonus creatures who eat it and spend Hit Point Dice during that rest each regain an extra 1d8 Hit Points.

**Bolstering Treats.** With 1 hour of work, or when you finish a Long Rest, you can make a number of treats equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you have ingredients and Cook's Utensils. The treats stay good for 8 hours. A creature can eat one as a Bonus Action to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Crossbow Expert
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Ignore Loading.** You ignore the Loading property of crossbows.

**Firing in Melee.** Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't give you Disadvantage on attack rolls with crossbows.

**Dual Wielding.** When you make the extra attack from the Light property with a crossbow that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to that attack's damage if you aren't adding it already.

feats.name: Crusher
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Push.** Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Bludgeoning damage, you can push it 5 feet to an unoccupied space if it is no more than one size larger than you.

**Enhanced Critical.** When you score a Critical Hit that deals Bludgeoning damage, attack rolls against that creature have Advantage until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Parry.** While you hold a Finesse weapon, when another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn. This can turn that hit into a miss.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Enhanced Dual Wielding.** When you take the Attack action and attack with a weapon that has the Light property, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action with a different melee weapon that doesn't have the Two-Handed property. You don't add your ability modifier to that attack's damage unless it is negative.

**Quick Draw.** You can draw or stow two weapons without the Two-Handed property at the moment you could normally draw or stow one.

feats.name: Durable
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Defy Death.** You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

**Speedy Recovery.** As a Bonus Action, you can spend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll it, and regain that many Hit Points.

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Energy Mastery.** Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Your spells ignore Resistance to that damage type. When you roll damage for a spell that deals that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

**Repeatable.** You can take this feat more than once, picking a different damage type each time.

feats.name: Fey Touched
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Fey Magic.** Pick one level 1 spell from the Divination or Enchantment school. You always have it and Misty Step prepared. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast them with spell slots you have. Their spellcasting ability is the one this feat increased.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Heavy Weapon Mastery.** When you hit a creature with a weapon that has the Heavy property as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.

**Hew.** Right after you score a Critical Hit with a melee weapon, or drop a creature to 0 Hit Points with one, you can make one attack with that same weapon as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Heavily Armored
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Armor Training.** You gain training with Heavy armor.

feats.name: Heavy Armor Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Constitution or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Damage Reduction.** While you wear Heavy armor, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take from attacks is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Inspiring Leader
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Bolstering Performance.** When you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can give a stirring speech. Up to six allies within 30 feet who can see or hear you, and you can be one of them, each gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level plus the modifier of the ability this feat increased.

feats.name: Keen Mind
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Lore Knowledge.** Pick Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion. You gain proficiency in that skill, or Expertise in it if you are already proficient.

**Quick Study.** You can take the Study action as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Lightly Armored
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Armor Training.** You gain training with Light armor and Shields.

feats.name: Mage Slayer
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Concentration Breaker.** When you damage a creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to keep Concentration.

**Guarded Mind.** If you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you do this, you can't do it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feats.name: Martial Weapon Training
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Weapon Proficiency.** You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.

feats.name: Medium Armor Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Dexterous Wearer.** While you wear Medium armor, you can add up to 3, instead of 2, from your Dexterity modifier to your AC. This matters only with a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

feats.name: Moderately Armored
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Armor Training.** You gain training with Medium armor.

feats.name: Mounted Combatant
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Mounted Strike.** While mounted, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is smaller than the mount.

**Leap Aside.** While you ride it, if your mount is hit by an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, it takes no damage on a success and only half on a failure.

**Veer.** While mounted and not Incapacitated, you can make an attack that hits your mount hit you instead.

feats.name: Observant
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Keen Observer.** Pick Insight, Investigation, or Perception. You gain proficiency in that skill, or Expertise in it if you are already proficient.

**Quick Search.** You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

feats.name: Piercer
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Puncture.** Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice. You must use the new roll.

**Enhanced Critical.** When you score a Critical Hit that deals Piercing damage, you roll one more damage die for the extra damage.

feats.name: Poisoner
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Potent Poison.** Your Poison damage ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

**Brew Poison.** You gain proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit. With 1 hour of work, the kit, and 50 GP of materials, you make doses of poison equal to your Proficiency Bonus. As a Bonus Action, you can coat a weapon or up to two pieces of ammunition with one dose; it lasts 1 minute or until it hits. A creature it hits makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the modifier of the ability this feat increased + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure it takes 2d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Polearm Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Pole Strike.** Right after you take the Attack action and attack with a Quarterstaff, a Spear, or a weapon that has both the Heavy and Reach properties, you can make one attack with the weapon's other end as a Bonus Action. It deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage plus the same ability modifier.

**Reactive Strike.** While you hold one of those weapons, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against a creature that enters your reach.

feats.name: Resilient
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Saving Throw Proficiency.** You gain saving throw proficiency in the ability this feat increased.

feats.name: Ritual Caster
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Ritual Spells.** Pick level 1 spells with the Ritual tag, as many as your Proficiency Bonus. You always have them prepared and can cast them with any spell slots you have. Their spellcasting ability is the one this feat increased. Each time your Proficiency Bonus goes up later, you can add one more level 1 Ritual spell.

**Quick Ritual.** Once per Long Rest, you can cast one of these Ritual spells without a spell slot using its normal casting time, not the longer ritual time.

feats.name: Sentinel
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Guardian.** Right after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the Disengage action, or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against it.

**Halt.** When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, its Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

feats.name: Shadow Touched
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Shadow Magic.** Pick one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school. You always have it and Invisibility prepared. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast them with spell slots you have. Their spellcasting ability is the one this feat increased.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Bypass Cover.** Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

**Firing in Melee.** Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't give you Disadvantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons.

**Long Shots.** Attacking at long range doesn't give you Disadvantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons.

feats.name: Shield Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Shield Bash.** Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 5 feet of you with a melee weapon as part of the Attack action, you can bash it with your Shield. It makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure, you push it 5 feet away or knock it Prone, your choice.

**Interpose Shield.** While you hold a Shield, if an effect lets you make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage at all on a success.

feats.name: Skill Expert
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Skill Proficiency.** You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

**Expertise.** Pick one skill you are proficient in that doesn't have Expertise yet. You gain Expertise in it.

feats.name: Skulker
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Blindsight.** You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

**Fog of War.** During combat, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks you make as part of the Hide action.

**Sniper.** If you make an attack roll while hidden and miss, the miss doesn't give away where you are.

feats.name: Slasher
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Hamstring.** Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can lower its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

**Enhanced Critical.** When you score a Critical Hit that deals Slashing damage, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Speedy
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Speed Increase.** Your Speed goes up by 10 feet.

**Dash over Difficult Terrain.** When you take the Dash action on your turn, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

**Agile Movement.** Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

feats.name: Spell Sniper
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Bypass Cover.** Your spell attack rolls ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

**Casting in Melee.** Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't give you Disadvantage on spell attack rolls.

**Increased Range.** When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and needs an attack roll, its range goes up by 60 feet.

feats.name: Telekinetic
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Minor Telekinesis.** You learn the Mage Hand spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the hand invisible, and its range and how far it can go from you both grow by 30 feet. If you already know the spell, these changes apply to it. Its spellcasting ability is the one this feat increased.

**Telekinetic Shove.** As a Bonus Action, you can push one creature you can see within 30 feet of you with your mind. It makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + the modifier of the ability this feat increased + your Proficiency Bonus) or is moved 5 feet toward or away from you.

feats.name: Telepathic
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Telepathic Utterance.** You can speak with your mind to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. It understands you only if it knows a language you know, and it can't answer you with its mind.

**Detect Thoughts.** You always have the Detect Thoughts spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it with spell slots you have. Its spellcasting ability is the one this feat increased.

feats.name: War Caster
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Concentration.** You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws you make to keep Concentration.

**Reactive Spell.** When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can take a Reaction to cast a spell at it instead. The spell must take one action to cast and must target only that creature.

**Somatic Components.** You can do the Somatic components of spells even while you hold weapons or a Shield in both hands.

feats.name: Weapon Master
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Mastery Property.** You can use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, as long as you are proficient with it. When you finish a Long Rest, you can switch to another kind of weapon.

feats.name: Blind Fighting
feats.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

feats.name: Dueling
feats.description: While you hold a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

feats.name: Interception
feats.description: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage that target takes by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus. You must be holding a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon.

feats.name: Protection
feats.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to raise your Shield, if you hold one. The triggering attack and every other attack roll against that target have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn, as long as you stay within 5 feet of it.

feats.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
feats.description: You can draw a weapon with the Thrown property as part of the attack you make with it. When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a Thrown weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

feats.name: Unarmed Fighting
feats.description: Your Unarmed Strike can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier, or 1d8 plus your Strength modifier if you hold no weapons or Shield when you attack. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to one creature Grappled by you.

feats.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Energy Resistances.** You gain Resistance to two damage types of your choice from Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, and Thunder. When you finish a Long Rest, you can change them.

**Energy Redirection.** When you take damage of one of those types, you can take a Reaction to send some of it at another creature you can see within 60 feet. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or takes 2d12 plus your Constitution modifier damage of that type.

feats.name: Boon of Fortitude
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Fortitude.** Your Hit Point maximum goes up by 40. Also, when you regain Hit Points, you can regain extra Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you do this, you can't again until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Boon of Recovery
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Last Stand.** When you would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum. Once you do this, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.

**Recover Vitality.** You have a pool of ten d10s. As a Bonus Action, you can spend dice from it, roll them, and regain Hit Points equal to the total. Spent dice come back when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Boon of Skill
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**All-Around Adept.** You gain proficiency in every skill.

**Expertise.** Pick one skill that doesn't have Expertise yet. You gain Expertise in it.

feats.name: Boon of Speed
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Escape Artist.** As a Bonus Action, you can take the Disengage action. Doing so also ends the Grappled condition on you.

**Quickness.** Your Speed goes up by 30 feet.
